lines: Try not to blink next time, {player}.
That makes the score {villager_wins} to {villager_losses}. Not that I am counting.
You brought courage. I brought results.
A fine attempt, {player}. Almost convincing.
The whole village saw that one.
I could offer lessons, but they would cost extra.
Still feeling gutsy, {player}?
I won the wager and the bragging rights.
You move well?for someone I just beat.
Remember this score: {villager_wins} wins for me, {villager_losses} for you.
That arena suited me nicely.
No hard feelings. Just a very clear winner.
I expected a challenge and received a warm-up.
Tell your friends I fought bravely. Tell them I won, too.
Whenever you are ready for another lesson, wait out the cooldown.
You won. There, I said it.
Do not look so pleased with yourself, {player}.
The score is {villager_wins} to {villager_losses}. I can still turn it around.
I had you exactly where I wanted you. Briefly.
The sun was in my eyes. Somehow.
Enjoy the wager. I will earn it back.
I have fought better days.
Everyone saw that, did they? Wonderful.
Next time I am bringing a better plan.
A loss is practice wearing an ugly hat.
You were faster than I expected, {player}.
I am not sulking. I am reviewing tactics.
One bout does not settle everything.
Fine work. Do not make me compliment you twice.
I will remember that strike. Mostly because it still hurts.
You want to test yourself against me? Choose how we fight and what rides on it. We stay inside the marked ring until one of us falls or time is called.
A challenge? Good. Name the weapons and the wager, {player}. We settle it inside the ring.
So you have come looking for a fair fight. Choose our gear, name the stakes, and let courage decide the rest.
Back for another bout? Our score is {villager_wins} victories to {villager_losses} in my favor. Choose your terms.
Another challenge, {player}? The score stands {villager_wins} to {villager_losses}. Name your terms.
You remember the score: {villager_wins} for me, {villager_losses} for you. Let us hear what you propose this time.
How shall we fight? If we use matched gear, your belongings will be kept safe until the duel is over.
Choose the tools of our contest. Anything set aside will be returned when the fight is done.
Fists, blades, bows, armor, or the gear on our backs. What kind of fight do you want?
How shall we fight? Choose matched gear, and your belongings will be kept safe until the duel is over.
Choose the tools of our contest. We use equal gear here, and your belongings will be returned when the fight is done.
Fists, blades, bows, or full armor. What kind of fair fight do you want?
And what rides on the fight? I can match a wager of up to {maximum_wager} {currency}.
Pride alone, or something more? I can cover as much as {maximum_wager} {currency}.
Name the wager. Neither of us can put up more than {maximum_wager} {currency}.
Those are your terms, then? Look me in the eye and make your challenge.
Weapons chosen. Wager named. Say the word, {player}.
No more bargaining. Challenge me, and we settle this in the ring.
Then the challenge is made. Ready yourself.
Agreed. Meet me in the ring.
Done. Steel your nerves, {player}.
No. Dueling is forbidden here.
No. I have no taste for fighting you.
Find someone else. I want no part of this.
Absolutely not. I am no duelist.
Not while I am under contract.
We stand together. We do not duel each other.
Look at me. I am in no state to fight.
Not now. Other duties bind me.
During a raid? Save your strength for our enemies.
Not now. I have other trouble to settle.
Not yet. Give me time before we fight again.
One bout at a time, {player}. Come back later.
No. I will not duel you again.
Finish the duel you already started.
You can see that I already have an opponent.
Come closer if you mean to challenge me.
No. This challenge cannot be made.
Very well. Name your terms.
